unlisted_practices: Precomputing a provenance-linked knowledge graph of the EHR at ingestion instead of reprocessing raw records at query time
Graph-guided LLM extraction of a deduplicated, temporally coherent clinical timeline
Agentic interface for tumor board preparation

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a new system architecture (VISTA Architect: knowledge graph plus LLM/agentic interface) for EHR timeline synthesis in tumor boards, comparing it against alternative retrieval baselines rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
